## Workflow 1b — WAHA Webhook Receiver

Second entry point, alongside workflow 1 (Meta). WAHA calls this URL
directly (`WHATSAPP_HOOK_URL` in docker-compose.yml) when
`WHATSAPP_CONNECTOR=waha`.

### Why it hands off to the SAME workflow 2
Rather than reimplementing dedup/assignment/Sheets logic for a second
connector, this normalizes WAHA's payload into the exact envelope shape
workflow 2 already parses from Meta. Everything downstream — dedup,
conversation assignment (workflow 3), Sheets writes — runs unmodified.

### Scope of this first cut — see docs/WAHA_CONNECTOR.md
Text messages only. Media messages are passed through as a labelled
placeholder rather than dropped or crashing. Not yet proven against a real
scan-and-message round trip — only WAHA's container health and QR issuance
are verified live.
